title: Frequency Experience: the Android app in mobile/ shows the member's stamp cards, codes and Zaps, checks in by tapping a tag, and drives the CyberUnicorn over USB or Bluetooth

source.ref: Owner request 2026-10-19, relayed by the coordinating session: build DEF-MOBILE now on Android as Frequency Experience, member experience plus CyberUnicorn 5000 control (ADR-1865).

detail: FILED 2026-10-19 (ADR-1865). BUILT on branch live/frequency-experience: mobile/ (Expo SDK 58, Expo Router) with Home, Rewards (GET /api/v1/rewards), Check in (phone NFC via react-native-nfc-manager, /n/<id> deep links, pasted links, POST /api/v1/nodes/{id}/capture with location when allowed), email sign-in with the session in SecureStore and POST /api/v1/session/bootstrap, push registration (POST /api/v1/push/devices); the CyberUnicorn remote on protocol v1 over USB (local Kotlin module, CH340 115200 8N1, DTR and RTS never asserted) and Bluetooth LE (Bruce serial service, MTU 517), with Light Show, LED, sound, sensors, the screen D-pad, a cli.run console and the Frequency tag writer (GET /api/v1/spaces/checkin-links). Internet relay is a coming-soon placeholder. THE CONSEQUENCE STILL OPEN: nothing has run against the real board or a real account. It closes when a development build on the owner's phone signs in, shows a stamp card, checks in by tapping a tag, and runs system.status over both USB and Bluetooth. Owner steps: EAS project and Firebase config for Android push, frequency://auth/callback on the Supabase redirect allow-list (OWN-091), ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS (LIVE-714).

verify.evidence: 2026-10-19: mobile typecheck, lint and node tests pass; the two routes' vitest suite passes. Not yet installed on a phone or connected to the CyberUnicorn.
